name: Hunter
summary: A ranger who specializes in bringing down dangerous prey.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.short: Choose Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer or Horde Breaker.
features.summary: You gain one of the following features.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.summary: Once per turn, +1d8 damage to a creature below its hit point maximum.

options.name: Giant Killer
options.summary: Reaction: attack a Large or larger creature within 5 ft. that attacks you.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.summary: Once per turn, attack a second creature within 5 ft. of your target.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.summary: You gain one of the following features.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.summary: Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.summary: After a creature hits you, +4 AC against its other attacks this turn.

options.name: Steel Will
options.summary: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

features.name: Multiattack
features.summary: You gain one of the following features.

options.name: Volley
options.summary: Action: ranged attack against any number of creatures within a 10 ft. radius.

options.name: Whirlwind Attack
options.summary: Action: melee attack against every creature within 5 ft.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.short: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide or Uncanny Dodge.
features.summary: You gain one of the following features.

options.name: Evasion
options.summary: DEX saves for half damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

options.name: Stand Against the Tide
options.summary: Reaction: when a creature misses you in melee, make it hit another creature.

options.name: Uncanny Dodge
options.summary: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you.
